correctness.rationale: Kernel K_a=(a+1)^-1 1_{x+y>0} on [-1,1] has complete mixed Dirichlet–Neumann sine eigenbasis φ_m=sin((2m+1)π(x+1)/4), eigenvalues 4(-1)^m/[π(a+1)(2m+1)]. Doob conjugation by φ0 gives Q-spectrum ν_m=(-1)^m/(2m+1), stationary ρ=h² and normalized f_m=φ_m/h; a cancels. For each fixed x>-1, one-step density belongs to L²(ρ), allowing spectral expansion; higher modes are O_x(5^-n) (after f1) and O_x(7^-n) (after f2). f1(x)=3−4sin² u vanishes only at u=π/3 (x=1/3), while f2(1/3)=−1. Exact sign-resolved L1(ρ) integrals give displayed coefficients 3√3/(4π)|f1(x)| and (5/(6π))(sinπ/5+sin2π/5). Strictly positive two-step kernel ensures unique invariant law. Independently verified sine eigenvalues, zero location, and L1 constants by direct integration; finite check is not proof of infinite spectrum.
